summary: Edge of a planted traffic island between road ramps, nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings near (retail 44 m), but the kerb is an island edge in full view of junction traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a planted island at a junction; no lane to pull out of, no cars parked, no vehicle tracks.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane junction with constant traffic on all sides.
drivers.convention: No parking here and no signs.

flags: Imagery differs: QLD shows construction works, Esri shows finished island
sun_shade: Open to sky, low shrubs only.
